queries.query: 淮阴区 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 可视化查询 官方 淮安市自然资源和规划局
queries.scope: Find Huaiyin-specific registered-parcel services and any anonymous public full-vector route.
queries.result: Huai’an Natural Resources and Planning Bureau describes an integrated “Online Su Xiaodeng · Huai’an E Service” platform and a real-estate unit health-code query that combines the registry ledger, house/unit diagrams, cadastral plans, and online visual cadastral-map lookup. The map lookup is attached to an identified real-estate unit; the page does not publish an anonymous vector endpoint or feature schema. A 2025 official award notice for the Huai’an cadastral-map compilation project explicitly assigns package 2 to Lianshui, Jinhu, Xuyi, and Huaiyin districts and calls for completing cadastral-survey results, parcel-geometry updates, and database compilation on the 2025/2026/2028 schedule.
queries.executionMethod: Chinese-language searches and direct reads of the city Natural Resources Bureau article and municipal procurement award; no login, health-code, parcel-identifying, or owner query was submitted.

This is local registry/data evidence, not evidence of an open vector feed.
technicalBlocker: The city describes map viewing inside a real-estate-unit health-code/registration workflow, and the district service portal exposes no parcel feature endpoint or schema. No access-controlled query or health-code lookup was attempted.
